{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "docs",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches doc/REST-interface.md for documentation following code changes.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The change to doc/REST-interface.md is incidental documentation updating the interface documentation alongside code changes."
    },
    {
      "name": "indexes",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies src/index/txindex.cpp, src/index/txindex.h, and src/index/tx_lookup_result.h to allow txindex on pruned nodes.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.7,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Lifts the mutual exclusivity between -txindex and -prune to let storage-constrained nodes index transactions. This resolves multiple long-standing user requests (#10609, #12651, #16182, #35240) by supporting tx lookups that return candidate block hashes for pruned blocks."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Changes src/rpc/request.cpp, src/rpc/util.cpp, src/rpc/rawtransaction.cpp, and src/rest.cpp, adding error.data support to JSONRPCError.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.45,
      "reason_tag": "user request",
      "rationale": "Extends JSONRPCError with an error.data object to supply candidate pruned block hashes when querying pruned transactions. This enables callers to programmatically identify missing blocks and fetch them via getblockfrompeer."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches test/functional/test_runner.py only to register new txindex tests.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Tests added (feature_txindex_prune.py) pin the behavior of txindex rather than modifying the test framework itself."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Modifies src/init.cpp to allow -txindex with -prune during configuration initialization.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The change in src/init.cpp solely loosens configuration validation for txindex and prune, which belongs to index initialization rather than shared utilities."
    }
  ],
  "factors": {
    "security_stability": 0,
    "bug_severity": 0,
    "performance": 0,
    "user_value": 3,
    "leverage": 1
  }
}
